about: Hell's soundtrack (Docs/Story.md, "Music"): which Hawkes Gen take each game file is cut from and how. Made by Tools/Audio/music-mix.py from the takes (hawkesgen_job <job> save_to <folder>). Takes made 2026-10-18 with audio.music (ACE-Step 1.5 XL turbo); the loops with the sickofit floor-music preset. Picked from waveforms and spectrograms against the brief.

tracks.why: Full groove from the first bar (the other take spends 14 s on an intro), with a breakdown midway that keeps a 90 s loop from droning.
After its intro, 80 s at full tilt with no breakdown: a push is heard in 10-25 s bursts, so it must be intense everywhere.
A steady, swaggering main section with a lead line that develops across it; the other take breaks down halfway.
Busy, fast lead runs over the whole take (the solo); the other is a flat wall of sound.
The only take that swells into one big accent (at ~6.4 s) and then just rings out; cut to a short swell, the hit and the ring.
The only take with a rising sweep into a slam (at ~1.8 s); the sweep is slowed to fill the 3.4 s fall so the slam lands on FLOOR 1,000.
Its notes climb into a held high chord; cut so the chord lands about as the marker arrives (a 9-10 floor climb).
